messages:
mira: Heads-up — port congestion in Baja (MXL) just bumped the ETA on the Wave-37 H100 batch. Forwarder reports container hold ~48–72h.
mira: This will impact the H100 replacement pool for west region. Anyone on vendor side have alternate routing suggestions? @luis fyi for customs/classification risk.
bintech_ops: Sorry about the scramble — confirmed: one of the reefers at MXL hit a customs inspection queue. We can offer two options: 1) split-air the priority 8 H100s via NVOCC to SFO (expedite, +12% freight) or 2) hold at MXL and consolidate next day for sea push (no extra freight but +72h). Both need AWB/manifest tweaks.
samir: Cost delta for option 1 (air-split) — can you itemize freight + handling + any insurance delta? we want a quick estimate before approving.
bintech_ops: Air-split pricing rough: freight +12% on top of PO freight, handling $480 per unit for air manifesting, provisional insurance increase +0.8% declared value. If you want a consolidated invoice we can send now.
julia: For option 1, what's the realistic pickup-to-door for SFO DC? we need dock slot lead times; SFO docks are tight next 3 days.
bintech_ops: ETA to SFO DC after air-split: 36–48h transit + 12–24h customs clearance on arrival. SFO dock booking window currently +18h; can push for priority slot but incur carrier rush fee.
luis: Customs note — air-split will change HS code handling (coming from MEX to US by air). We need export docs re-affirmed (commercial invoice + ECCN). If they re-declare as "spare parts" instead of "complete units" that will trigger different duties. Keep consistent with PO.
mira: OK. Contingency plan: If bintech_ops can secure air-split for the 8 H100s, we want them auto-routed to our Dedicated pool (pool-ded-west) and marked as RMA replacements (so they don't hit general allocation). Can vendor tag them in manifest as REDWOOD-RMA so we can auto-claim on arrival?
bintech_ops: Yes — we can add REDWOOD-RMA in the manifest reference field. We'll also upload AWB manifest numbers to the portal. Preliminary AWBs: \n```
AWB: 915-22233344\nAWB: 915-22233345\nAWB: 915-22233346\n```
bintech_ops: Will push final docs by +2h. We also need a PO-change confirmation to bill the rush fee.
samir: Approved conditional on billing being consolidated to PO# 2024-9087 and vendor credit for 1-day demurrage (if any). Please send formal invoice addendum.
julia: Logistics ask — when items arrive SFO, can ops-team get pre-alert with freight dims/weights and a handling checklist? we may need extra fork/trap for H100 crates.
logistics-bot: Ticket created: LOG-2024-7621 — "MXL hold -> SFO air-split for H100 replacements". Assigned to @julia and vendor-bintech_ops. ETA for docs: +2h.
luis: Also verify serial range mapping — we need the serial list attached to the AWBs so our inventory team can auto-assign to pool. If any serials are missing vendor must supply within 6h of arrival.
mira: Important: For any DOA returns we want RMA pickup instructions in the same manifest so we can do 1:1 swap at dock (no extra inbound quarantine). bintech_ops, can you include RMA return labels for 4 DOA units we flagged earlier?
bintech_ops: Affirmative — we'll append outbound return labels and the RMA portal links. Portal link: https://vendor.bintech.example.com/rma/submit?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9087
bintech_ops: Quick note on customs risk: if Mexican customs release is delayed beyond 72h we will recommend diversion to PHX air-hub instead of SFO to avoid repeated port re-queues. That will add ~4–8h transit but lower chance of additional inspection.
samir: Fine with diversion to PHX as fallback. Please include cost delta in the invoice addendum.
mira: Good. @julia @luis — once AWBs are posted, let's run the pooled allocation script to earmark units. Code snippet to run after AWB upload:\n```
# earmark replacements to pool-ded-west
python ops/earmark.py --pool pool-ded-west --ref REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 915-22233344,915-22233345,915-22233346
```
julia: Copy. I'll stand by to book SFO dock if we confirm air-split. Will also email facilities to prep an extra crate fork.
logistics-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h check-in on LOG-2024-7621
mira: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please drop final docs here when ready. :thumbsup:
bintech_ops: Will do. Uploading docs in ~90m and confirming PO addendum now. :white_check_mark:
